page_title: Let's Enhance: AI Image App to Upscale, Sharpen & Improve Quality Online | Try Free

summary.name: Let's Enhance
summary.one_liner: Let's Enhance is an AI image tool that upscales, sharpens, and improves the quality of photos, AI art, logos, and scanned images online.
use_cases: Upscale low-resolution photos for posters or canvas prints
Clean up and upscale Midjourney or Stable Diffusion outputs
Enhance and enlarge product photos in bulk for e-commerce
Restore old, soft, or compressed scanned photos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI enhancer that recovers detail and corrects color and exposure, aiming for natural results without plastic skin or halos. The upscaler increases resolution up to 16x so images can reach 300 DPI at larger print sizes. It sharpens edges, reduces noise, and repairs soft focus, compression damage, and old scans. The stated workflow is three steps: upload an image, choose an enhancement type, and download the result. The page also mentions bulk enhancement for product catalogs and cleanup of AI-generated art up to 4K or 8K.
notable: Upscales images up to 16x while targeting 300 DPI print resolution
Covers photos, AI art, logos, and scanned images in one tool
Bulk enhancement for product photo catalogs
Offers video tools and an API alongside the image tools
caveats: Page says 'Free to start' in the meta description but does not give pricing details, so paid tiers are likely but not confirmed
Output resolution and bulk limits are not specified on the page
